title: Search Provider Adapter — Normalized Result
description: The shape every search-provider adapter (Tavily, Brave) must normalize its raw HTTP response into, before the results array is passed to collect_research_sources() as its `sources` parameter. Keeps provider-specific response shapes out of the SQL layer and out of every workflow downstream of source collection. See docs/architecture/research-pipeline.md#provider-architecture.

request_id.description: Provider-assigned request/trace ID, if any — stored on the cost_event, never logged as a secret.
